Synthesis:
RFC 2606 (BCP 32) reserves four top-level domains:.test for DNS testing,.example for documentation,.invalid for deliberately invalid names, and.localhost for loopback use. It also reserves example.com, example.net, and example.org for documentation [1]. RFC 6761 defines their special-use behavior: example domains resolve normally, while.test,.invalid, and.localhost receive special handling [2]. Use these names instead of real domains in examples and tests. [3]
